data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable prior year claims development of GBP 20.2m (2014 - GBP 19.8m) was experienced in 2015, predominantly in respect of Property and Marine lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims activity due to the benign claims environment.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a favourable prior-year reserve movement in 2015 of GBP 20.2m (a release), driven by benign claims activity and the absence of major catastrophe events. The report explicitly attributes the improvement predominantly to Property and Marine lines. No specific named catastrophe events were cited as drivers of the prior-year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable prior year claims development of GBP 20.2m (2014 - GBP 19.8m) was experienced in 2015, predominantly in respect of Property and Marine lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims activity due to the benign claims environment.
absence of any major catastrophic events

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development taken from Note 16 narrative which explicitly states a GBP 20.2m favourable prior-year development. A gross claims development triangle is present and yields a small net adverse movement if calculated by diagonal comparison; however the report narrative explicitly states a GBP 20.2m favourable movement and that wording has been used as the authoritative gross PYD. All monetary figures in the accounts are presented in GBP '000; primary fields here have been converted to millions. LOB-level prior-year amounts are not quantified in the report (only stated as 'predominantly' Property and Marine).
